tokens.name: garden-paper
tokens.usage: Сад: the light cream page ground — lighter than the fills so gold and sand stand out.

tokens.name: garden-raised
tokens.usage: Сад: cream-white cards, the search pill, sheets, the bottom nav.

tokens.name: garden-tint
tokens.usage: Сад: empty progress tracks, the sheet handle, tile borders.

tokens.name: garden-peach
tokens.usage: Сад: Фрази tile; streak tile. Only garden-ink text on it.

tokens.name: garden-blush
tokens.usage: Сад: Важкі слова tile, correction card. garden-ink, garden-primary, garden-wrong text all pass.

tokens.name: garden-sand
tokens.usage: Сад: the light main fill — secondary buttons, chips, the active nav pill, the header's light end, Порядок слів tile. garden-ink text 9:1.

tokens.name: garden-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Сад: Картки tile, example card — a muted olive-khaki. Only garden-ink text on it (5.1:1).

tokens.name: garden-ink
tokens.usage: Сад: all text; passes on every Сад ground including the camel header (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: garden-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Сад: secondary text on paper, raised, tint, peach, blush (5:1+). Not on camel or periwinkle.

tokens.name: garden-primary
tokens.usage: Сад: the gold main fill — primary buttons, the nav's centre button, the header, progress fills, chart bars. Text on it is garden-on-primary (dark brown, 6.6:1); never cream text. As a fill on garden-paper it is 1.8:1, so it never carries meaning without a label.

tokens.name: garden-on-primary
tokens.usage: Сад: text and icons on garden-primary gold (6.6:1).

tokens.name: garden-rust
tokens.usage: Сад: rust accent as text and small marks — de/het, links, «Усі». On paper, raised, tint, blush only.

tokens.name: garden-mustard
tokens.usage: Сад: sparkle — stars, the streak flame. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: garden-forest
tokens.usage: Сад: correct, and the verb role in word order; on paper, raised, tint, blush, peach. Always with a word.

tokens.name: garden-wrong
tokens.usage: Сад: wrong answers and the danger button; text on paper or raised (4.9:1+), white text on it 5.4:1. Always with a word.

tokens.name: garden-slate
tokens.usage: Сад: cool dark accent — the subject role in word order. On paper, raised, blush only.

tokens.name: garden-olive
tokens.usage: Сад: the time/adverbial role in word order. On paper, raised, tint, blush only.

tokens.name: garden-line
tokens.usage: Сад: hairline dividers inside cream cards.

tokens.name: garden-role-adverbial
tokens.usage: Сад word-order schema: обставина — the tile's bottom edge, the segment's top band and its label, on garden-raised or garden-sand.

tokens.name: garden-role-negation
tokens.usage: Сад word-order schema: заперечення — the tile's bottom edge, the segment's top band and its label, on garden-raised or garden-sand.

tokens.name: garden-role-connector
tokens.usage: Сад word-order schema: сполучник — the tile's bottom edge, the segment's top band and its label, on garden-raised or garden-sand.

tokens.name: garden-role-adjective
tokens.usage: Сад word-order schema: прикметник — the tile's bottom edge, the segment's top band and its label, on garden-raised or garden-sand.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App today: Page background behind the single 640px column; also the sticky deck bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App today: Cards, inputs, dialogs, the drawer, word tiles in the pile.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: App today: Default button fill, hints, rule examples, answer tiles, stat tiles inside a stats card.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: App today: All body copy and headings on bg, surface and soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: App today: Secondary copy: field labels, table headers, progress lines, ghost buttons, icon buttons. On bg/surface/soft (4.5:1 in both themes on bg; light on soft is 4.3:1, keep it ≥14px).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: App today: 1px hairlines on every control, card and table row; the 4px bottom edge of a neutral word tile. Decorative, not a control boundary that must meet 3:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: App today: The one brand hue (Dutch orange): primary buttons, the active drawer link and pressed chips/segments, bar-chart bars, de/het articles, learning status, focus ring, rule examples' left rule.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: App today: Text on an accent fill. White in light, stone-900 in dark because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: App today: Destructive buttons, wrong-answer message, mistake counters, the error notice. Same red in both themes; as text on dark surface it is only 3.3:1 (source pair kept) — pair it with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: App today: Text on a danger fill (Видалити, notice, mistake badge).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: App today: Correct-answer message, learned status, easy difficulty, a correct word-order answer border.

tokens.name: difficulty-medium
tokens.usage: App today: Medium difficulty badge. Hard-coded in the source as #b45309 for both themes; on dark surface it reads 3.3:1 — flagged.

tokens.name: role-subject
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: subject segment (top band and role label).

tokens.name: role-verb
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: verb (finite verb / V2 slot).

tokens.name: role-object
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: object.

tokens.name: role-adverbial
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: adverbials of time/manner/place.

tokens.name: role-negation
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: niet / geen.

tokens.name: role-connector
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: conjunctions (omdat, dat, en…).

tokens.name: role-adjective
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: adjectives.

tokens.name: role-other
tokens.usage: App today: Word-order schema: any other part.
